lines.en: Sakaki-bar-a — a place where everyone knows your name. Unless your name is Akira.
lines.zh: : Sakaki-bar-a——一个所有人都知道你名字的地方。除非你的名字是 Akira。

lines.en: If that’s the case, chances are you didn’t even know your name until recently. And also, you have a terrible hobby/addiction and need to find a new one ASAP.
lines.zh: : 真是那样的话,你多半直到最近才知道自己的名字。而且,你还有一个糟糕的爱好/瘾,得尽快换一个。

lines.en: Anyway, a quick taxi ride takes us right up to the doors, but I notice right away that things don’t seem as...hectic as they’ve been lately.
lines.zh: : 总之,一小段出租车车程把我们直接送到门口,但我立刻注意到,这里似乎不像最近那么……喧闹。

lines.en: The streets are quiet and empty, and the only sound that can be heard apart from my two friends bickering is the electric hum of a new sign Sara bought with some of the bar’s profits.
lines.zh: : 街道安静而空旷,除了我两位朋友的斗嘴,唯一能听到的声音,是 Sara 用酒吧的部分利润买的新招牌发出的电流嗡鸣。

lines.en: I push open the doors and guide the two of them to my normal seat, which isn’t entirely necessary as it’s not their first time here, but it does make me feel cool.
lines.zh: : 我推开门,把她们俩引到我的固定座位——虽然完全不必要,这又不是她们第一次来,但这样让我感觉很酷。

lines.en: But what makes me feel even cooler is that Sana, who appears to be the only one working tonight, quickly brings all three of us beers without me even needing to part my lips.
lines.zh: : 而让我觉得更酷的是:Sana——今晚唯一在班上的人——很快为我们三个端来了啤酒,而我连嘴都没张。

lines.en: Which brings us to now, roughly thirty minutes and three beers deep into the night as smooth jazz drones on in the background.
lines.zh: : 于是就到了现在:大概三十分钟、三瓶啤酒下肚,背景里流淌着平滑爵士。

lines.en: : Say, why don’t we come here more often? I didn’t even realize this place was open for non-events and shit.
lines.zh: : 话说,我们为什么不常来这里?我都不知道这家店平时也营业什么的。

lines.en: : Do you think it might have something to do with the fact that our regular bar is only a couple blocks away from my apartment?
lines.zh: : 你觉得会不会和「我们的固定酒吧离我公寓只有几个街区」这件事有关?

lines.en: : I have no clue. That’s why I asked.
lines.zh: : 我毫无头绪。所以才问的。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I think it has something to do with the fact that our regular bar is only a couple blocks away from my apartment.
lines.zh: : 好。嗯,我觉得可能确实和「我们的固定酒吧离我公寓只有几个街区」有关。

lines.en: : Wakana and Osako don’t live that close by, though.
lines.zh: : 不过 Wakana 和 Osako 住得没那么近吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you know the two of them are getting up to no good on the train. Wouldn’t put it past either of them to stakeout the busiest cars during rush hour just so they can live out some fantasies.
lines.zh: : 是,但你知道她们俩在电车上没干好事。她们完全可能蹲守高峰期最挤的车厢,好实现某些幻想。

lines.en: : I fingered Rie on the train once. But I’m a ninja so no one noticed.
lines.zh: : 我在电车上给 Rie 用过手指。但我是忍者,没人发现。

lines.en: : Very nice, Rika. But you might want to watch what you’re saying in front of one of the girls who is literally in the club you advise.
lines.zh: : 很好,Rika。但你可能要注意一下言辞——眼前就站着一位真真正正属于你顾问社团的女孩。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Hi Sana. Please don’t report me to upper management. They’re scary and I need money for rat college.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。嗨,Sana。请不要向管理层举报我。他们很可怕,而我需要钱给老鼠上大学。

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about that...I’ve heard much worse from my mom’s friends and-
lines.zh: : 你不用担心那个……我从我妈的朋友那里听过糟糕得多的,而且——

lines.en: : Did you say “rat college?”
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是说「老鼠上大学」?

lines.en: : It’s for her son.
lines.zh: : 是给她儿子上的。

lines.en: : Yup! But I just found out he doesn’t have much time left...
lines.zh: : 没错!但我刚刚得知,他的时间不多了……

lines.en: : I’m sure...Rin will be happy to...not be an only child anymore...even if it’s only for a little while...
lines.zh: : 我确信……Rin 会很高兴……不再是独生女……哪怕只有一小段时间……

lines.en: : Can you get me another beer, Sana? Whenever you have a second.
lines.zh: : Sana,能再给我来一杯啤酒吗?你有空的时候。

lines.en: : Mhm. I just need to...finish putting away the wine glasses...I’m running behind since...I’m working alone again tonight...
lines.zh: : 嗯。我只需要……把酒杯先收好……我进度落后了,因为……今晚又是我一个人上班……

lines.en: : Yeah, the hot biker girl was here last time!
lines.zh: : 对,上次那个机车辣妹在!

lines.en: : Where’s she tonight? I have to get her number and find out how she feels about the female body. Or how she feels the female body. Whatever comes first. Probably her. I’m a ninja.
lines.zh: : 她今晚在哪?我必须拿到她的号码,顺便搞清楚她对女性身体的看法。或者她怎么「感受」女性身体。哪个先来都行。多半是她。我是忍者。

lines.en: : I...actually don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……其实不知道……

lines.en: : She was supposed to work tonight, but...she just...hasn’t shown up, so...I’m just glad we’re slow...
lines.zh: : 她今晚本来要上班的,但是……她就是……没出现,所以……我很高兴今天客人少……

lines.en: : Has that happened before? I thought Yuki had been really good when it came to work stuff?
lines.zh: : 以前发生过吗?我记得 Yuki 在工作的事情上一直很靠谱?

lines.en: : New boyfriend maybe? Girlfriend? Did I manifest her into being gay? If so, I’m sorry. Just not really.
lines.zh: : 交新男友了?还是女友?难道是我把她「许愿」成同性恋了?如果是,我道歉。但也没有很真心。

lines.en: : Bitch, you two have talked like one time. Keep yo’ damn pants on.
lines.zh: : 贱人,你们俩统共说过一次话。把你的破裤子穿好。

lines.en: : Well gee, Imani. Sorry. Not all of us can just willingly be abstinent for seven years.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,Imani。抱歉。不是所有人都能自愿禁欲七年。

lines.en: : She’s...never done this before, but...I’m sure she just...made a mistake when she...looked at the schedule or something...
lines.zh: : 她……从来没这样过,但是……我确信她只是……看排班表的时候……出了个错什么的……

lines.en: : It’s not a...big deal...
lines.zh: : 这不是……什么大事……

lines.en: : Do you...actually have a crush on her?...
lines.zh: : 你……是不是真喜欢她?……

lines.en: : No, she just has a crush on everyone.
lines.zh: : 不,她只是对所有人都有好感。

lines.en: : Perpetual loneliness will do that to a person.
lines.zh: : 永恒的孤独会把人变成那样。

lines.en: : Ninjas do not know emotion. I’m a lone wolf who stalks the shadows. I just think it’d be cool to make out with her.
lines.zh: : 忍者不懂情感。我是独行于阴影中的孤狼。我只是觉得和她亲热会很酷。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m pretty sure my mom does too...
lines.zh: : 是啊……我相当确定我妈也这么想……

lines.en: : Man! Isn’t there anyone around here who isn’t already interested in somebody else? Am I really gonna have to date that Nodoka girl who keeps trying to pull me into the storage room?
lines.zh: : 天!这附近难道就没有一个人,不是已经心有所属的吗?难道我真得去约会那个老想把我拽进储藏室的 Nodoka 女孩?

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re gonna want to stay as far away from her as possible. And I ain’t just saying that because of the age gap.
lines.zh: : 是的,你会想离她越远越好。而且我这么说可不只是因为年龄差。

lines.en: : I know. Shit’s just hard, man.
lines.zh: : 我知道。只是日子难熬啊,伙计。

lines.en: : You go from thinking you’re gonna be spending the rest of your life with one girl...raising a kid together...buyin’ a damn house...and then it’s just over? That’s it?
lines.zh: : 你本来以为会和一个女孩共度余生……一起养孩子……一起买栋该死的房子……然后就那么结束了?就这样?

lines.en: : Like...I’m not trying to bring down the mood since this is supposed to be a celebration and all, I just wish I had somebody to share happy moments with, you know?
lines.zh: : 我不是想扫兴,毕竟这本来是个庆祝的场合,我只是希望,也有人能和我分享快乐的瞬间,你懂吧?

lines.en: : And now, to top things off, I might have to watch Wakana and Osako go through the same song and dance I had with Rie. There’s just misery and lesbian sadness everywhere I look. Rin and Otoha too.
lines.zh: : 而现在,雪上加霜的是,我可能还得眼睁睁看 Wakana 和 Osako 重演一遍我和 Rie 的戏码。放眼望去,全是悲惨和蕾丝边的哀伤。Rin 和 Otoha 也是。

lines.en: : Rin will be fine. It seems like she’s basically over Otoha already.
lines.zh: : Rin 不会有事的。她看起来基本已经放下 Otoha 了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that probably means she’s just gonna fall for Chika again and get a third dose of heartbreak before I even get a shot at a second.
lines.zh: : 是,但这多半意味着她只会再次栽进 Chika 怀里,在我等到第二春之前先吃第三次心碎。

lines.en: : Rika, as someone who’s...already been through a tough breakup...what do you think is going to happen to Wakana and Osako?
lines.zh: : Rika,作为一个……已经经历过惨烈分手的人,你觉得 Wakana 和 Osako 会走向哪?

lines.en: : That’s...tough. Nobody on the outside can ever really understand what’s going on in somebody else’s relationship.
lines.zh: : 这……很难说。门外汉永远无法真正理解别人关系里在发生什么。

lines.en: : My gut instinct is that they’ll be able to work through it. But my gut’s not always right since I thought I’d be able to work stuff out with my partner too.
lines.zh: : 我的直觉是她们能挺过去。但我的直觉不总准——我当年也以为我能和我的伴侣把事情解决好。

lines.en: : Neither of them really, like...talk to me the way you guys do. So it’s not like I really know what’s going on in the first place. I just...feel the tension. The bad kind. Not the kind you guys have.
lines.zh: : 她们俩都不太……像你们这样跟我说话。所以我本来就不清楚她们那边在发生什么。我只是……能感觉到那种张力。坏的那种。不是你们俩那种。

lines.en: : But I guess the bright side to all of this sad stuff is that you two are actually hooking up now!
lines.zh: : 不过,这些伤心事里唯一的亮点是:你们俩真的开始做了!

lines.en: : Uh...you okay, Sana?
lines.zh: : 呃……你还好吗,Sana?

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : That glass was just a little slippery, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是那个杯子有点滑,仅此而已。

lines.en: : You...need us to help clean it up or anything?
lines.zh: : 需要……我们帮你收拾吗?

lines.en: : No, that’s okay. But I think I might have cut my hand.
lines.zh: : 不用,没关系。不过我好像把手割破了。

lines.en: : Sensei, could you come to the kitchen and help me wrap it up please?
lines.zh: : Sensei,能请你到厨房来帮我包扎一下吗?

lines.en: : Uh...sure.
: I’ll be...right back, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……我大概……马上回来。

lines.en: : Are those two fucking?
lines.zh: : 那两个在搞吗?

lines.en: : Rika, ew! What the fuck?!
lines.zh: : Rika,恶心!什么鬼?!

lines.en: : What?! That felt weird as hell, didn’t it?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!刚才那个氛围怪到家了,不是吗?!

lines.en: : So your gut instinct is to think they’re having sex?!
lines.zh: : 所以你的直觉就是「她们在做」?!

lines.en: : I already told you my gut’s been wrong before! I’m just calling it like I see it! I hope it’s not true either! That’s gross and bad news for you!
lines.zh: : 我早说过我的直觉错过!我只是看到什么说什么!我也不希望是真的!那很恶心,而且对你是个坏消息!

lines.en: : Hah...that was just a one time thing, unfortunately. It’s not like we’re actually dating.
lines.zh: : 哈……那只是一次性的,很遗憾。又不是我们真在交往。

lines.en: : True. But, speaking from experience, you don’t go down on somebody for hours at a time if you don’t want to date them.
lines.zh: : 倒也是。但以经验之谈,如果你不想和人约会,你不会一给就是好几个小时。

lines.en: : Once you pass the sixty-minute mark, it means something. So at least you’ve got that, buddy.
lines.zh: : 一旦跨过六十分钟大关,它就有了含义。所以至少这一点你有了,伙计。

lines.en: : You really think that’s true?...
lines.zh: : 你真觉得是这样?……

lines.en: : Absolutely. Not a doubt in my mind.
lines.zh: : 绝对是。没有一丝怀疑。

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!

lines.en: : You’ve gotta tell me all about it. How’d it happen? Did he actually know what he was doing? Was it really just oral? Spare no detail. I must know.
lines.zh: : 你必须把一切告诉我。怎么发生的?他真的知道自己在干什么吗?真的只有口?细节一个都别省。我必须知道。

lines.en: : It was amazing. And so unexpected too. I had no idea it was even coming.
lines.zh: : 太棒了。而且完全出乎意料。我连它要来都不知道。

lines.en: : Was it at your place? His place? Love hotel? Where?
lines.zh: : 在你家?他家?情人旅馆?哪里?

lines.en: : A room at an inn on the beach. The place we use for all the class beach trips.
lines.zh: : 海边一家旅馆的房间。就是班级海滩旅行一直用的那个地方。

lines.en: : You did it during the class beach trip?! You frisky little freaks, you!
lines.zh: : 你们在班级海滩旅行时做的?!你们这两个小骚货!

lines.en: : It was right before the class trip, actually. We went there on...our own. With nobody else.
lines.zh: : 其实是在班级旅行之前。我们自己……去了那里。没有别人。

lines.en: : We spent the whole day together...I told him some stuff about my past...
lines.zh: : 我们待了一整天……我告诉了他一些我过去的事……

lines.en: : Then, when we went back to the room, I showed him my swimsuit and he was just like “take it off!” So of course I was nervous as hell but...oh my god.
lines.zh: : 然后我们回房间后,我给他看了我的泳衣,他直接说「脱掉!」所以我当然紧张得要死,但是……我的天。

lines.en: : I kid you not, I had no idea it was even physically possible to cum so many times in one- are you crying?
lines.zh: : 我不骗你,我根本不知道一天里来那么多次在生理上是可能的——你在哭吗?

lines.en: : I’m just...so happy for you...
lines.zh: : 我只是……太为你高兴了……

lines.en: : Me too, man! But don’t cry! You’re killing the vibe and I want to tell you more about how friggin’ awesome it was.
lines.zh: : 我也是,伙计!但别哭!你毁气氛了,我还想多讲讲那有多他妈的棒。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I’m sorry! I’d just given up on the possibility of the two of you ever getting together, so this is all so crazy to me.
lines.zh: : 对不起,对不起!我只是早就不指望你们俩有可能在一起了,所以这一切对我太震撼了。

lines.en: : Well, don’t just...count me out, yo. Senpai and I have been close since day one. I wouldn’t have been able to hold out as long as I have if I didn’t think it was possible.
lines.zh: : 好了,别随便……把我排除出局嘛,哟。学姐和我从第一天起就亲近。要不是我觉得有可能,我早就撑不到现在了。

lines.en: : Of course it’s possible! It’s obviously possible. It basically happened. I just figured it was going to be Wakana before you.
lines.zh: : 当然可能!明显可能。基本已经发生了。我只是以为会先是 Wakana,而不是你。

lines.en: : But...Wakana’s with Osako. The two of them have been together since college. We literally just talked about this.
lines.zh: : 可是……Wakana 和 Osako 在一起。她们俩大学就在一起了。我们刚才不还聊到这个。

lines.en: : I mean, yeah. But you see the way she and Akira look at each other sometimes, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说,对。但你看到过她和 Akira 有时的对视,对吧?

lines.en: : Are you really gonna look at me and tell me those two don’t want to fuck each other into a coma? We all know it. Hell, Osako probably knows it too. That might be why they’re fighting.
lines.zh: : 你真的能看着我的眼睛说,那两个人不想把对方干到昏迷?我们都知道。说实话,Osako 八成也知道。说不定她们吵架就是因为这个。

lines.en: : Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait. There’s no way Senpai would be the reason they’re fighting. And just because they might want to take each other’s clothes off doesn’t mean Wakana actually would.
lines.zh: : 等等等等等等。学姐绝不可能是她们吵架的原因。而且就算她们可能想扒对方的衣服,也不代表 Wakana 真的会。

lines.en: : She loves Osako. She tells me about it all the time. She’s loyal as all hell.
lines.zh: : 她爱 Osako。她一直跟我念叨。她忠诚得要命。

lines.en: : I’m not saying she would actually cheat. Just that if I were in Osako’s shoes and I had a feeling my partner wanted to screw somebody else, I’d probably say or do some pretty stupid shit.
lines.zh: : 我不是说她真会出轨。只是如果我是 Osako,感觉伴侣想和别人上床,我大概也会说出或干出一些蠢到家的事。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you say and do pretty stupid shit all the time without being in that very specific scenario, so that’s just...not a good sample.
lines.zh: : 可你平时不需要那种特定场景,也整天说蠢话干蠢事,所以这个样本……不作数。

lines.en: : And that’s a totally fair counterpoint thingy! I probably am wrong. You’re the one he actually hooked up with in the end, so you’re the one who’s winning now.
lines.zh: : 这反驳相当公正!我多半真错了。最后真正和他上床的人是你,所以现在赢的人是你。

lines.en: : Saying I’m winning makes it sound like a contest, though...
lines.zh: : 说「赢」听起来像比赛……

lines.en: : Love is a contest, Imani. And it’s one that never ends, so you’ve always gotta be competing.
lines.zh: : 爱就是比赛,Imani。而且是一场永不结束的比赛,所以你必须一直比下去。

lines.en: : There are like ten million people on this planet, and any one of them could snatch away the person you’re after if you let your guard down. You gotta remember that.
lines.zh: : 这颗行星上有差不多一千万人,你稍一松懈,他们中的任何一个都可能把你追逐的人抢走。你要记住这一点。

lines.en: : Rika, there are almost eight billion people on earth.
lines.zh: : Rika,地球上有将近八十亿人。

lines.en: : Wha- well, that’s like five times worse, damn it!
lines.zh: : 什——那岂不是糟糕五倍,该死!

lines.en: : How did you get a job at a school?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么在学校找到工作的?

lines.en: : How did you get a job at being eaten out by a hot young stud?!
lines.zh: : 你又是怎么找到「被火辣小鲜肉口」这份工作的?!

lines.en: : That isn’t my job, you friggin’ weirdo!
lines.zh: : 那不是我的工作,你这个怪人!

lines.en: : Yeah, but it should be!
lines.zh: : 但应该是!

lines.en: : I know Akira’s type, Imani. I hooked up with plenty of dudes like that in my teens who probably went on to bang like a hundred girls. Which is why I’m telling you you’ve gotta lock that dude down.
lines.zh: : 我懂 Akira 的类型,Imani。我十几岁时睡过一堆那种男人——他们后来大概都睡了一百个女孩。所以我才告诉你,你必须把那个男人锁死。

lines.en: : Sex might be the goal right now, but that’s not all you really want in the end, is it? You want somebody to share happy moments with too. You’re like me. New me. Not old me.
lines.zh: : 性也许只是眼前的目标,但那终究不是你真正想要的,对吧?你也想要有人分享快乐的瞬间。你和我一样。新的我。不是旧的我。

lines.en: : Well, technically old me. But old me is the new me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,严格来说是「旧的我」。但旧的我,就是新的我。

lines.en: : Old like age. Like, new me is old of age. And old me is-
lines.zh: : 「旧」是指年纪。就是,新的我年纪大。而旧的我——

lines.en: : Yeah, I get what you’re trying to say. And...
lines.zh: : 行,我知道你想说什么了。而且……

lines.en: : And...you’re right. Maybe this is one big contest. But could you really say I’m winning right now when we’ve only done shit one time?
lines.zh: : 而且……你说得对。也许这确实是一场大赛。可我们才做过一次,你真能说现在赢的是我?

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I’m almost positive I’m losing since he fucked some other girl like crazy in the room right next door to me once. I just can’t say who since I signed an NDA.
lines.zh: : 事实上,我几乎可以肯定输的是我——因为他曾经就在我隔壁房间,把另一个女孩干得死去活来。我没法说是谁,因为我签了保密协议。

lines.en: : Then that’s all the more reason to fight, girl. You’ve come this far, haven’t you? Go give that dude the ride of his life. So long as that’s not what Sana’s doing as we speak.
lines.zh: : 那就更该战斗了,姑娘。你都走到这一步了,不是吗?去给那个男人一场此生最棒的体验。只要不是 Sana 此刻正在做的事就行。

lines.en: : Wait, yeah. Those two have been gone for a while.
lines.zh: : 等等,对。那两位消失有一阵子了。

lines.en: : I said what I said and I won’t say it again.
lines.zh: : 我说过了,而且不再重复。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you think we should, like...go check on them?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们是不是……该去看看她们?

lines.en: : I don’t know. I kinda want to stay out here and keep talking about sex since, depressingly, you are now defeating me in that area of my life.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我有点想继续待在外面聊性话题——因为令人沮丧的是,你现在在「我人生的这个领域」打败我了。

lines.en: : Well, hopefully you’ll be able to convert the neighbor soon.
lines.zh: : 那希望你早点把邻居转化成功。

lines.en: : Hopefully. Because other than that, my best option seems to be becoming the third member of a threesome with you and Akira. And I can’t do that without disrupting the dynamic of our friend group.
lines.zh: : 希望。不然的话,我最好的选择,似乎就是当你和 Akira 三人行的第三位。而那样做,难免打乱我们朋友圈的格局。

lines.en: : I mean...would it reeeeeeally disrupt anything?
lines.zh: : 我是说……真的会打乱「任——何」东西吗?

lines.en: : Can’t some friends just have a one-off night of...sexual exploration without completely changing the dynamic of-
lines.zh: : 难道朋友之间,就不能有一晚偶尔的……性探索,而不彻底改变朋友圈的——

lines.en: : You motherfucker.
lines.zh: : 你这个混账东西。

lines.en: : It wasn’t my idea! I wanted a nice, old-fashioned one-on-one encounter! They pressured me!
lines.zh: : 那不是我的主意!我想要的是一场体面的、老派的一对一!是她们逼我的!

lines.en: : Unforgivable! You participated in a night of platonic passion while I was feeding a cheese wheel to a rat?!?! How could you do this to me?!
lines.zh: : 不可原谅!我在给一只老鼠喂奶酪轮的时候,你们居然进行了一夜柏拉图式的激情?!?!你怎么能这样对我?!

lines.en: : It was before you ever met the rat! I swear!
lines.zh: : 那是在你遇见老鼠之前!我发誓!

lines.en: : Hey. What’s going on? What happened with the-
lines.zh: : 嘿。怎么了?洗手间那边怎么样——

lines.en: : You! Both of you! Let me smell you! I need to make sure nothing inappropriate happened!
lines.zh: : 你!你们两个!让我闻闻!我必须确认没有发生任何不恰当的事!

lines.en: : Wha- Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 什——Sensei?!

lines.en: : Run.
: I...aah! The wound on my...hand reopened! I must...dress it!
lines.zh: : 我……啊!我手上的……伤口裂开了!我必须……包扎它!

lines.en: : Get back here or I’ll never teach you paradiddles, damn it!
lines.zh: : 给我回来,不然我永远不教你复合跳,该死!

lines.en: : I don’t even know what that means!!!!!
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道那是什么!!!!!

lines.en: Sana manages to escape, and I manage to go undetected as Rika thoroughly inspects my body and finds nothing. Probably because I never laid a finger on Sana the entire time I was in the kitchen.
lines.zh: Sana 成功逃脱,而我成功未被发现——Rika 把我的身体彻头彻尾检查了一遍,一无所获。多半是因为,我在厨房的整个过程中,确实没对 Sana 动过一根手指。

lines.en: That does not mean, however, that she did not lay a finger on me.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表,她没有对我动过一根手指。

lines.en: Or a mouth.
lines.zh: : 或者一张嘴。

lines.en: On my penis.
lines.zh: : 在我的 penis 上。

lines.en: But that is beside the point.
lines.zh: : 不过这是题外话。

lines.en: I sit back down at the counter and quickly find that I still have not received the new beer I asked for earlier. Probably because the bartender was going down on me.
lines.zh: : 我回到吧台坐下,很快发现:我先前点的那杯新啤酒依然没有出现。多半因为酒保当时正忙着给我口。

lines.en: That’s fine, though. It’s getting late anyway.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。反正也晚了。

lines.en: Imani and Rika finish their drinks a short while later. But, before we leave, there’s a moment of silence where the three of us just...sit there.
lines.zh: : 不久之后,Imani 和 Rika 喝完了各自的酒。但在离开前,有一段静默——我们三个就那样……坐着。

lines.en: The jazz music continues to drone on and Rika closes her eyes. But I’m unsure of whether or not she’s just tired or absorbed in the song.
lines.zh: : 爵士乐继续低吟,Rika 闭上了眼睛。我分不清她是累了,还是沉浸在歌里。

lines.en: Regardless, it gives me the chance for one more bout of prolonged eye contact with Imani...and she smiles that same smile she always does.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,这让我又有机会和 Imani 长久对视……而她露出了那个一如既往的微笑。

lines.en: But the light blue in her eyes seems a little bit darker and I can’t tell quite why.
lines.zh: : 只是她眼中那一点淡蓝,似乎暗了一些;我说不清为什么。

lines.en: We leave the bar. All three of us. And I never get to say goodbye to Sana. Nor do I get to see Imani and Rika off as it makes more sense for me to just head home from here.
lines.zh: : 我们离开了酒吧。三个人一起。而我始终没能和 Sana 道别,也没能目送 Imani 和 Rika 离开——从这里直接回家更顺路。

lines.en: I had a good time, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,我很尽兴。

lines.en: I hope they did too.
lines.zh: : 我希望她们也是。

lines.en: Rika’s affection has increased to [rika_love]!
lines.zh: Rika 的好感度提升到了 [rika_love]!

lines.en: Imani’s affection has increased to [imani_love]!
lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!

lines.en: Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!
